title: Buyer’s guide
description: A checklist of the documents and questions to cover before you buy an apartment, commercial space or plot in Bangladesh.

data.title: Before you buy: a short checklist
data.intro: The documents and questions that protect you, whoever you buy from.

data.body:
Documents to ask for

  1. The deed and the mutation (khatian) records for the land.
  2. The RAJUK approval letter and the approved drawings.
  3. The allotment agreement, including the payment schedule and handover date.

Questions to ask

Who holds the title, what happens if the project is delayed, and what is included in the price? A reliable developer answers all three in writing.
